sentences.text: Correcting charts is a basic duty.
Start with the edition date of your chart, then check every Local Notice to Mariners issued since that date for corrections that affect it.
On paper charts, mark corrections neatly and record them in a correction log, so you know the chart is up to date.
On chartplotters, install chart updates regularly, since an old memory card can be years out of date.
When sources disagree, use the most recent information and navigate with extra caution.
